title: New GitHub, PyPI Policies Hope to Boost Supply Chain Security - Slashdot

content_html:
"GitHub and the Python Package Index (PyPI) have introduced new policies meant to boost supply chain security," reports SecurityWeek, "by preventing the fast propagation of poisoned package versions and the poisoning of old and long-stable releases." To prevent the fast delivery of malicious code through the immediate fetching of brand-new releases, GitHub has introduced a Dependabot cooldown, where the automation tool waits for at least three days after a release has been published before opening a pull request. "Waiting a few days before adopting a new release gives maintainers, security researchers, and automated scanners time to spot a malicious version and get it pulled before it ever reaches your pull requests," GitHub explains.

The three-day cooldown only applies to non-security version bumps, and the behavior can be modified through the configuration option in the dependabot.yml. "Three days as the default balances two goals: it pushes you past the window where most of these attacks live, and it doesn't hold your dependencies back longer than necessary," GitHub notes.


And the Python Package Index (PyPI) "now rejects new files being uploaded to releases that are older than 14 days," according to a recernt blog post from the Python Software Foundation's security developer-in-residence Seth Larson: This restriction was put in place to prevent old and long-stable releases from being poisoned in case publishing tokens or workflows of PyPI projects were compromised... The discussion of this behavior began during PEP 740 (Digital Attestations) back in January 2024. The discussion was restarted in March 2026 after the popular packages LiteLLM and Telnyx were compromised. These packages were compromised due to a "mutable reference" in these projects' usage of the Trivy GitHub Action...

To quantify how disruptive this change would be to existing workflows, the PyPI database was queried for projects that have published new files to old releases... [O]nly 56 projects of 15,000 had published a [Python] 3.14-compatible wheel more than 14 days after a release was available. This topic was brought to the Packaging Summit at PyCon US 2026 by PyPI Safety & Security Engineer, Mike Fiedler. The rough consensus of the discussion was that the summit attendees thought it was "acceptable to require users to bump to the next version" to support new Python versions. With the data and consensus in hand, Seth moved forward with a patch to reject new files on old releases which was merged July 8th, 2026.

sentences.en: "GitHub and the Python Package Index (PyPI) have introduced new policies meant to boost supply chain security," reports SecurityWeek, "by preventing the fast propagation of poisoned package versions and the poisoning of old and long-stable releases."
sentences.zh: SecurityWeek 报道称：“GitHub 和 Python Package Index (PyPI) 引入了新策略，旨在通过防止有毒软件包版本的快速传播以及旧版本和长期稳定版本的中毒来提高供应链安全性。”

sentences.en: To prevent the fast delivery of malicious code through the immediate fetching of brand-new releases, GitHub has introduced a Dependabot cooldown, where the automation tool waits for at least three days after a release has been published before opening a pull request.
sentences.zh: 为了防止通过立即获取全新版本来快速交付恶意代码，GitHub 引入了 Dependabot 冷却时间，其中自动化工具在版本发布后至少等待三天，然后再打开拉取请求。

sentences.en: "Waiting a few days before adopting a new release gives maintainers, security researchers, and automated scanners time to spot a malicious version and get it pulled before it ever reaches your pull requests," GitHub explains.
sentences.zh: GitHub 解释说：“在采用新版本之前等待几天，可以让维护人员、安全研究人员和自动扫描程序有时间发现恶意版本，并在它到达您的拉取请求之前将其拉取。”

sentences.en: The three-day cooldown only applies to non-security version bumps, and the behavior can be modified through the configuration option in the dependabot.yml.
sentences.zh: 三天的冷却时间仅适用于非安全版本升级，并且可以通过 dependentabot.yml 中的配置选项修改行为。

sentences.en: "Three days as the default balances two goals: it pushes you past the window where most of these attacks live, and it doesn't hold your dependencies back longer than necessary," GitHub notes.
sentences.zh: GitHub 指出：“默认三天可以平衡两个目标：它将你推过大多数此类攻击发生的窗口，并且不会将你的依赖项保留的时间超过必要的时间。”

sentences.en: And the Python Package Index (PyPI) "now rejects new files being uploaded to releases that are older than 14 days," according to a recernt blog post from the Python Software Foundation's security developer-in-residence Seth Larson: This restriction was put in place to prevent old and long-stable releases from being poisoned in case publishing tokens or workflows of PyPI projects were compromised...
sentences.zh: 根据 Python 软件基金会常驻安全开发人员 Seth Larson 最近发表的一篇博文，Python 包索引 (PyPI)“现在拒绝将新文件上传到超过 14 天的版本”：实施此限制是为了防止旧的和长期稳定的版本在发布令牌或 PyPI 项目工作流程受到损害的情况下被毒害......

sentences.en: The discussion of this behavior began during PEP 740 (Digital Attestations) back in January 2024.
sentences.zh: 对这种行为的讨论始于 2024 年 1 月的 PEP 740（数字证明）。

sentences.en: The discussion was restarted in March 2026 after the popular packages LiteLLM and Telnyx were compromised.
sentences.zh: 在热门软件包 LiteLLM 和 Telnyx 遭到泄露后，讨论于 2026 年 3 月重新启动。

sentences.en: These packages were compromised due to a "mutable reference" in these projects' usage of the Trivy GitHub Action...
sentences.zh: 这些包由于这些项目使用 Trivy GitHub Action 中的“可变引用”而受到损害...

sentences.en: To quantify how disruptive this change would be to existing workflows, the PyPI database was queried for projects that have published new files to old releases... [O]nly 56 projects of 15,000 had published a [Python] 3.14-compatible wheel more than 14 days after a release was available.
sentences.zh: 为了量化这一变化对现有工作流程的破坏性，我们在 PyPI 数据库中查询了已将新文件发布到旧版本的项目...在版本可用后 14 天以上，15,000 个项目中只有 56 个项目发布了 [Python] 3.14 兼容轮。

sentences.en: This topic was brought to the Packaging Summit at PyCon US 2026 by PyPI Safety & Security Engineer, Mike Fiedler.
sentences.zh: 该主题由 PyPI 安全工程师 Mike Fiedler 在 PyCon US 2026 包装峰会上提出。

sentences.en: The rough consensus of the discussion was that the summit attendees thought it was "acceptable to require users to bump to the next version" to support new Python versions.
sentences.zh: 讨论的粗略共识是，峰会与会者认为“要求用户升级到下一个版本”以支持新的 Python 版本是可以接受的。

sentences.en: With the data and consensus in hand, Seth moved forward with a patch to reject new files on old releases which was merged July 8th, 2026.
sentences.zh: 掌握了数据和共识后，Seth 继续推出补丁以拒绝旧版本上的新文件，该补丁于 2026 年 7 月 8 日合并。

content_html_zh: SecurityWeek 报道称：“GitHub 和 Python Package Index (PyPI) 引入了新策略，旨在通过防止有毒软件包版本的快速传播以及旧版本和长期稳定版本的中毒来提高供应链安全性。” 为了防止通过立即获取全新版本来快速交付恶意代码，GitHub 引入了 Dependabot 冷却时间，其中自动化工具在版本发布后至少等待三天，然后再打开拉取请求。 GitHub 解释说：“在采用新版本之前等待几天，可以让维护人员、安全研究人员和自动扫描程序有时间发现恶意版本，并在它到达您的拉取请求之前将其拉取。” 三天的冷却时间仅适用于非安全版本升级，并且可以通过 dependentabot.yml 中的配置选项修改行为。 GitHub 指出：“默认三天可以平衡两个目标：它将你推过大多数此类攻击发生的窗口，并且不会将你的依赖项保留的时间超过必要的时间。” 根据 Python 软件基金会常驻安全开发人员 Seth Larson 最近发表的一篇博文，Python 包索引 (PyPI)“现在拒绝将新文件上传到超过 14 天的版本”：实施此限制是为了防止旧的和长期稳定的版本在发布令牌或 PyPI 项目工作流程受到损害的情况下被毒害...... 对这种行为的讨论始于 2024 年 1 月的 PEP 740（数字证明）。 在热门软件包 LiteLLM 和 Telnyx 遭到泄露后，讨论于 2026 年 3 月重新启动。 这些包由于这些项目使用 Trivy GitHub Action 中的“可变引用”而受到损害... 为了量化这一变化对现有工作流程的破坏性，我们在 PyPI 数据库中查询了已将新文件发布到旧版本的项目...在版本可用后 14 天以上，15,000 个项目中只有 56 个项目发布了 [Python] 3.14 兼容轮。 该主题由 PyPI 安全工程师 Mike Fiedler 在 PyCon US 2026 包装峰会上提出。 讨论的粗略共识是，峰会与会者认为“要求用户升级到下一个版本”以支持新的 Python 版本是可以接受的。 掌握了数据和共识后，Seth 继续推出补丁以拒绝旧版本上的新文件，该补丁于 2026 年 7 月 8 日合并。
